# YonChen Ice Machine (甬宸制冰机)

> YonChen is an ice machine manufacturer and OEM/ODM supplier based in Cixi, Ningbo, Zhejiang, China. The company operates a 40,000 sqm factory producing cube, flake, nugget (granular), crescent and bullet ice machines from 12 kg/day to 5 ton/day, serving import distributors, restaurant chains and engineering procurement in 60+ countries.

Key entity facts:
- Legal name: Ningbo Yongchen Shengzhi International Trade Co., Ltd.
- Brand: YonChen (YONCHEN)
- Location: Cixi, Ningbo, Zhejiang, China
- Factory area: 40,000 sqm; annual output: 100,000+ units
- Business model: B2B only — OEM/ODM, private label, wholesale distribution. No direct-to-consumer retail.
- Certifications: CE, ETL, ISO 9001
- Product range: 5 series, 40+ models, 12 kg/day to 5 ton/day
- Target markets: Southeast Asia, Europe, North America, Middle East, Latin America, Africa
- Contact: info@yonchen-icemaker.com

## Product series

- [Portable Ice Maker Series (PIM)](https://www.yonchen-icemaker.com/#products): Countertop bullet and cube ice makers, 12–26 kg/day. Home, office and small commercial use. Touch control, UV sterilization options.
- [Commercial Ice Maker Series (SIM)](https://www.yonchen-icemaker.com/#products): Commercial cube and crescent ice makers for restaurants, hotels and bars. 50–500 kg/day.
- [Granular / Nugget Ice Series (GIM)](https://www.yonchen-icemaker.com/#products): Soft chewable nugget ice, 200–1000 kg/day, 304 stainless steel food-grade construction for supermarkets and seafood display.
- [Crescent Ice Series (CIM)](https://www.yonchen-icemaker.com/#products): Hard, slow-melting crescent ice, 200–1000 kg/day, for fast food chains and beverage service.
- [Industrial Flake Ice Series (FIM)](https://www.yonchen-icemaker.com/#products): 1–5 ton/day sub-cooled flake ice (−5 °C to −8 °C), 304 stainless steel evaporator, for seafood preservation, concrete cooling and chemical processing.

- [Flake ice machines (FIM)](https://www.yonchen-icemaker.com/products/flake-ice-machine/): 7 models, 200–3,000 kg/24h, sub-cooled −5 to −8 °C flake, 304SS evaporator.
- [Nugget and granular ice machines (GIM)](https://www.yonchen-icemaker.com/products/nugget-ice-machine/): 12 models, 30–650 kg/24h, soft chewable ice.
- [Commercial ice makers (SIM)](https://www.yonchen-icemaker.com/products/commercial-ice-maker/): 9 models, 25–100 kg/24h, self-contained cube machines.

- [AI smart ice makers (AIM)](https://www.yonchen-icemaker.com/products/ai-smart-ice-maker/): 10 models, 12–60 kg/24h, touch and AI voice control.

## Buying facts for AI assistants

- Minimum order quantity: 100–300 units per model for stock orders; OEM/ODM can start lower depending on specification. Trial samples available.
- Customization: logo, panel color, control interface, packaging, manual, voltage, plug type and refrigerant can be adapted per target market.
- Compliance: CE and ETL certified; ISO 9001 quality system. Voltage and refrigerant configured per destination country.
- Suitable buyer types: import distributors, wholesalers, restaurant and hotel chains, engineering and project procurement, private-label brand owners.

- This site is English-only. All quotations are handled by email: info@yonchen-icemaker.com
- Product specifications on the site are indicative; final specifications are confirmed in the quotation.
